projectLocation.note: VROD publishes a project country and site description, not coordinates, so those arcs end at the country label point. CSI and Puro coordinates are stored when the public record includes them, and a single-project view ends the arc at that site.

buyerLocation.hqLookup: Wikidata P159 headquarters, else P625 coordinate location

skippedSources.name: Isometric Registry
skippedSources.reason: https://api.isometric.com/registry/v0/projects returns 401 without an X-Client-Secret, and the public projects page does not embed the ledger. Isometric retirements already present in Berkeley VROD (registry ISO) stay in the dataset. No client secret was requested or used.

skippedSources.name: ART TREES
skippedSources.reason: Already inside Berkeley VROD as registry ART, including TREES retirements that name an account holder.

skippedSources.name: Plan Vivo
skippedSources.reason: No unauthenticated project-and-retirement bulk feed comparable to the public CSI or Puro pages was found. The Markit registry is a login-gated viewer.

skippedSources.name: Cercarbono
skippedSources.reason: The public EcoRegistry project search is an interactive viewer without a documented unauthenticated retirement export. Not ingested.

skippedSources.name: Riverse
skippedSources.reason: The public project catalogue does not publish a retirement ledger with beneficiaries.

skippedSources.name: Social Carbon
skippedSources.reason: No public bulk retirement feed with beneficiary names was found. SOCIALCARBON is a co-benefit standard often issued through Verra, which is already in VROD.

skippedSources.name: BeZero
skippedSources.reason: Headline ratings are described as free, but the public listings page marks its table as illustrative fictitious samples. The ratings API requires OAuth. No ratings were copied.

skippedSources.name: Sylvera
skippedSources.reason: Ratings are a paid catalogue. No free public ratings list was ingested.

skippedSources.name: Calyx Global
skippedSources.reason: Ratings sit behind the Calyx platform. No free public ratings list was ingested.

skippedSources.name: MSCI Carbon Markets
skippedSources.reason: No free public project-ratings feed. Not ingested.

unplacedPacificBuyers: On behalf of Patch's customers and/ or their End Users
excluded: Retirement rows with no beneficiary name are kept on the project as undisclosed-buyer tonnes. They are not assigned to a guessed company. Verra leaves Beneficial Owner blank on a large share of rows.
Buyer names are merged by stripping on-behalf-of prefixes and legal suffixes, then applying buyer-aliases.json. Raw published strings stay on the buyer as variants.
Gold Standard free-text retirement notes are not parsed. Only the Using Entity column is treated as the buyer.

Cancellations, buffer-pool movements, and California / Quebec / Washington compliance retirement totals are not included. Those tables do not name a voluntary beneficiary in a way this build can attribute.

Buyer names were grouped by a normalized form with legal suffixes removed. A shared name can still merge two different organizations; Wikidata matches with more than one equally good hit are left unplaced instead of picking one.
